body:
The collaborator-notification toggle defaults ON, but POST_NOTIFICATIONS is only
requested when the user flips the Settings toggle to on. On a fresh install the
toggle is already on, so that flip never happens -> permission never requested ->
canPost() silently returns false -> no notifications until the user grants it by
hand in system settings. Fix: request POST_NOTIFICATIONS automatically once, when
the user first lands in the app after login (if enabled + not granted, API 33+).
title: Android: notification permission is never auto-requested (always-on toggle means the flip-to-enable request never fires)
